description: Generate spoken-audio (text-to-speech) for a verse, prayer, or devotional in 50+ languages, and get back a playable audio URL. Pass BCP-47 language (e.g. en-US, es-ES, sw-KE), optional voice/gender. Results are cached. Requires an API key (audio generation has real cost).

format.description: Audio container/encoding of the returned URL.

gender.description: Preferred voice gender when a specific voice is not named.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag for the voice.

text.description: The text to synthesize into speech (a verse, prayer, or short devotional).
examples: For God so loved the world...

voice.description: Optional specific Google Cloud TTS voice name; overrides the default voice for the language.

name: synthesize_speech
